caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a reddish-brown finish. The tabletop is rectangular with rounded corners and visible wood grain texture. The table has two drawers at the front, each with a round decorative metal pull or handle. The table stands on two turned and fluted legs, each extending to a pair of curved feet with claw-like ends, each equipped with a small caster wheel. The legs are connected by a horizontal stretcher that is also ribbed. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or detail. The artist's signature, "FRANCES BORELLI," is written in the lower left corner outside the main composition.
title: Sofa Table
